name: probe_results
title: R2 position-level probe results (annotation sidestep)
description: Per (class x kind x layer): pooled AUROC + leave-one-trace-out AUROC of annotated onset/mid/end/pre_onset positions vs depth-matched within-trace controls; escape-vs-reheat (succ vs fail onsets, same class). Headline: cycle onset LOO 0.988-0.991 (n=128), loop 0.983-0.988 (n=78), muse 0.979-0.982 (n=5). Computed with the fixed Mann-Whitney auroc (2026-08-26). conf=clear only.
caveats: Observational (teacher-forced); pooled AUROC fits and evaluates on the same data (LOO is the honest number); onset AUROCs broadly high across layers — distributed signal or residual position confound.
